blocking: On desktop (index-desktop-4.jpg), the fixed header overlaps and slices through the top of the brown 'Reimagined Heritage' poster-frame CTA, cutting the cream wordmark in half right underneath the red header wordmark.

fixes.what: Increase top padding on .cta--poster (e.g., padding-top: calc(var(--header-h) + clamp(48px, 8vh, 80px))) and offset the inset border top: calc(var(--header-h) + 24px) on desktop, or hide/unstick the header when entering #cta.
fixes.why: In index-desktop-4.jpg, the fixed 96px cream header covers the top of the brown poster frame and slices the cream wordmark in half, creating a harsh visual collision of two stacked wordmarks.

fixes.what: Update --red from #9E1B32 to #D10C0C (or align with the SVG logo fill).
fixes.why: The brand book specifies #D10C0C for red, and the current #9E1B32 CSS token visibly mismatches the brighter red in logo-red.svg.

fixes.what: Change border-bottom: 1px solid var(--red) and border-top: 1px solid var(--red) to 2px solid var(--red).
fixes.why: The brand book forbids 1px grid hairlines; all structural kashida dividers must match the 2px stroke weight used in .pillar and .rule.

fixes.what: Remove transform: rotate(180deg) before the second transform declaration, and increase font-size to 15px with letter-spacing: 0.1em.
fixes.why: Duplicate transform property in CSS is redundant, and slightly more breathing room on the vertical accordion spine labels improves editorial legibility against blurred imagery.
